steps.objective: Rewrite the contract: change names inside quotes (ci"), words inside brackets (ci(), strike Clause 3 (dap), sign it (cit).

lines.speaker: npc
lines.name: Quire
lines.text:
The founding contract. Our chains began here.
Time to rewrite it.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.name: Folio
lines.text:
Change what's inside, not the brackets.
ci" for quotes, ci( for brackets.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.name: Index
lines.text:
One clause goes: dap. Sign it yourself: stand on
<name> before cit, or it rewrites everything.

line.speaker: npc
line.name: Quire
line.text:
Read, dust, file, copy. All of it ours
again. And a name at the bottom.

line.speaker: npc
line.name: Notary
line.text:
The Minotaur. I wrote 'nothing guards them'
because I was afraid to write the name.

line.speaker: system
line.text:
Under the Library, the Echo Caves.
Something down there is searching too.
